##### Project general facts

Mira Villas by Bentley Home, developed by MIRA Developments in collaboration with Luxury Living Group and Bentley Home, presents an exclusive collection of ultra-luxury villas in the prestigious Meydan district. Designed to embody the highest standards of craftsmanship and sophistication, each residence seamlessly blends contemporary architecture with the timeless elegance of Bentley Home interiors. The project offers a truly bespoke living experience, where every detail has been carefully curated to create homes that reflect exceptional quality, comfort, and refined taste.

The development is designed to deliver an elevated lifestyle where privacy, exclusivity, and luxury come together in a prestigious residential setting. Surrounded by the vibrant Meydan community, residents enjoy convenient access to Dubai's key destinations while experiencing an environment defined by elegance and tranquility. Every aspect of the project reflects MIRA Developments' commitment to creating exceptional residences that combine world-class design with uncompromising attention to detail.

Each villa is fully finished with premium-quality materials and is available in one of three distinctive interior design themes — Traditional, Formal, or Contemporary — allowing homeowners to select a style that best suits their personal preferences. The residences are delivered fully furnished with handcrafted Bentley Home furniture and feature fully equipped kitchens fitted with Gaggenau appliances, complemented by luxury tableware from Bernardaud, Baccarat glassware, Christofle cutlery, Lalique lighting, and Frette bed linens. To ensure complete peace of mind, every villa also includes a three-year complimentary maintenance warranty covering both the property and its furnishings. 

##### Location description and benefits

Wadi Al Safa 3 is situated in a prime location, surrounded by a plethora of amenities and attractions that cater to a wide range of interests and lifestyles. The iconic Meydan Racecourse is a major landmark in the area, hosting prestigious horse racing events that attract enthusiasts from around the world. Residents of Wadi Al Safa 3 have the privilege of witnessing the thrilling races firsthand and immersing themselves in the vibrant atmosphere that surrounds this prestigious venue. The area is also home to a variety of upscale restaurants and cafes, offering a diverse range of culinary experiences.

Wadi Al Safa 3 benefits from its proximity to major highways and public transportation networks, ensuring that residents can conveniently explore the city's vibrant attractions, business districts, and cultural landmarks. The area is also surrounded by expansive parks and landscaped gardens, providing a serene and tranquil environment that is perfect for leisurely walks, bike rides, or picnics. Green spaces are integral to the design of the area, with tree-lined boulevards and beautifully manicured lawns that create a sense of calm and well-being. The abundance of open spaces also provides opportunities for outdoor activities and social gatherings, fostering a sense of community and connection among residents.

Wadi Al Safa 3 is an extraordinary location that combines urban convenience with a tranquil and scenic environment, offering residents a unique living experience that is both refined and relaxing. The area is home to a variety of upscale amenities, including luxury shopping centers and fine dining restaurants, catering to the diverse needs and interests of its residents. With its prime location and plethora of amenities, Wadi Al Safa 3 is the perfect destination for those seeking a luxurious and sophisticated lifestyle, surrounded by the beauty and charm of Dubai's most exclusive neighborhoods.
